name: Variance-aware Adaptive Pixel Sampling
aliases: Adaptive pixel sampling for inverse rendering
definition: A technique that performs adaptive pixel sampling for inverse rendering by allocating samples on each pixel based on its contribution to the loss function and the forward/differentiable rendering variance, minimizing the variance of loss gradient estimates.
summary: Variance-aware adaptive pixel sampling accelerates inverse rendering by allocating a fixed pixel budget based on estimated loss gradient variance, minimizing gradient estimator noise more effectively than uniform or magnitude-only sampling.
